server.name: domainee
server.title: Domainee
server.description: Custom domains API for SaaS: connect, verify, and manage customer domains, SSL, and DNS

tools.name: tools_ssl_check
tools.title: SSL Certificate Check
tools.description: Free public API. Check the TLS certificate of any public hostname. Returns issuer, subject, validity dates, days until expiry, full chain, cipher, protocol, and SAN list. No Bearer required.

host.description: Hostname to check. Optionally with port, e.g. example.com:443.

ok.description: Always true here; failures return an isError result instead.

authorized.description: Chain validates against public roots and matches the hostname.

altNames.description: Subject Alternative Names (hostnames the cert covers).

chain.description: Leaf first, then intermediates and root.

outputSchema.description: TLS certificate details for the host.

tools.name: tools_dns_provider_lookup
tools.title: DNS Provider Lookup
tools.description: Free public API. Identify which DNS provider actually serves a domain, fingerprinted from its public NS records. Returns the record name written the way that provider's form expects it (providers disagree about whether the apex is '@', blank, or the full domain, and getting it wrong is the most common way a correct record lands in the wrong place), whether the provider can point a zone apex at a hostname, where its record editor lives, and the provider-specific settings that silently break custom domain setups. Use this before telling someone what DNS record to add. No Bearer required.

domain.description: Domain or hostname. Subdomains are walked up to the zone holding the NS records.

ok.description: Always true here; failures return an isError result instead.

zone.description: Zone that holds the NS records.

detected.description: false = provider not recognised from its nameservers.

recordName.description: What to type in this provider's record name/host field for this hostname.

apexSupport.description: 'alias' = can point the apex at a hostname (ALIAS/ANAME/flattening); 'none' = apex needs A records.

recordEditorPath.description: Where the DNS record editor lives in the provider's UI.

quirks.description: Provider-specific settings that silently break custom domain setups.

outputSchema.description: The DNS provider serving the domain and how to write records there.

tools.name: tools_domain_connect_checker
tools.title: Domain Connect Checker
tools.description: Free public API. Check whether a domain's DNS provider implements the Domain Connect protocol, read live from the _domainconnect TXT record and the provider's settings endpoint. Reports the provider and whether it offers the synchronous flow (a signed redirect with no token exchanged, the one that works in practice) or only the asynchronous OAuth flow. Note that provider support is necessary but not sufficient for one-click setup: the service being connected must also have a template the provider has synced and enabled, which many providers do only after a per-service onboarding. No Bearer required.

ok.description: Always true here; failures return an isError result instead.

supported.description: Provider implements Domain Connect (necessary, not sufficient, for one-click setup).

synchronous.description: Signed-redirect flow; the one that works in practice.

flows.description: Present only when supported is true.

outputSchema.description: Whether the domain's DNS provider implements Domain Connect.

tools.name: tools_dns_record_lookup
tools.title: DNS Record Lookup
tools.description: Free public API. Look up DNS records (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA) for any domain.

type.description: Restrict to one record type. Default: all common types.

ok.description: Always true here; failures return an isError result instead.

records.description: Map of record type (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA) to an array of answers ([] if none; MX entries are {exchange, priority}, SOA is one object), or {error} if that lookup failed.

outputSchema.description: DNS records for the domain, keyed by type.

tools.name: tools_whois_lookup
tools.title: WHOIS Lookup
tools.description: Free public API. WHOIS / RDAP lookup for a domain — registrar, status, created/updated/expires dates, nameservers.

ok.description: Always true here; failures return an isError result instead.

status.description: EPP status codes, e.g. client transfer prohibited.

outputSchema.description: RDAP registration data for the domain.

tools.name: tools_cname_lookup
tools.title: CNAME Lookup
tools.description: Free public API. Resolve a hostname's CNAME chain. Useful for debugging custom-domain CNAME setups.

ok.description: Always true here; failures return an isError result instead.

cnames.description: CNAME answers; empty if the host has no CNAME.

outputSchema.description: The hostname's CNAME target and what it resolves to.

tools.name: tools_http_header_checker
tools.title: HTTP Header Checker
tools.description: Free public API. Fetch a URL and return its response headers + security grade based on common security headers.

url.description: Full URL with scheme, e.g. https://example.com.

ok.description: Always true here; failures return an isError result instead.

outputSchema.description: Response headers and a security-header grade.

tools.name: tools_dns_propagation_checker
tools.title: DNS Propagation Checker
tools.description: Free public API. Query the same hostname across ~10 public DNS resolvers worldwide and report which ones return the same answer. Useful right after a DNS change.

ok.description: Always true here; failures return an isError result instead.

consistent.description: true when every resolver that answered returned the same set.

ok.description: false = resolver query failed (see error).

outputSchema.description: Answers from several public resolvers and whether they agree.

tools.name: tools_redirect_checker
tools.title: Redirect Checker
tools.description: Free public API. Follow a URL's redirect chain and return every hop with status code, response time, final destination.

ok.description: Always true here; failures return an isError result instead.

location.description: Location header, when the hop redirects.

outputSchema.description: Every hop of the URL's redirect chain.

tools.name: tools_spf_record_checker
tools.title: SPF Record Checker
tools.description: Free public API. Look up and validate the SPF record for a domain. Counts void/total DNS lookups, flags syntax issues, validates against RFC 7208's 10-lookup limit.

ok.description: Always true here; failures return an isError result instead.

lookupCount.description: DNS lookups consumed; RFC 7208 allows at most 10.

outputSchema.description: The domain's SPF record, parsed and validated.

tools.name: tools_domain_age_checker
tools.title: Domain Age Checker
tools.description: Free public API. Returns a domain's registration date, age in days + years, last-updated date, and expiration.

ok.description: Always true here; failures return an isError result instead.

outputSchema.description: Registration date and age of the domain.

tools.name: tools_subdomain_finder
tools.title: Subdomain Finder
tools.description: Free public API. Enumerate subdomains for a target domain via Certificate Transparency logs + DNS resolution.

ok.description: Always true here; failures return an isError result instead.

addresses.description: Resolved IPs; empty if not resolved.

outputSchema.description: Subdomains found via Certificate Transparency and a wordlist.

tools.name: tools_reverse_ip_lookup
tools.title: Reverse IP Lookup
tools.description: Free public API. Reverse-DNS (PTR) lookup for an IP address. Returns one or more hostnames if configured.

ok.description: Always true here; failures return an isError result instead.

sharedHosts.description: Other hostnames on this IP; null when unavailable.

outputSchema.description: PTR hostnames for the IP, plus co-hosted domains when available.

tools.name: tools_dmarc_record_checker
tools.title: DMARC Record Checker
tools.description: Free public API. Look up the DMARC record at _dmarc.<domain>, parse policy/alignment/reporting tags, flag missing or too-permissive settings.

ok.description: Always true here; failures return an isError result instead.

outputSchema.description: The domain's DMARC record, parsed and validated.

tools.name: tools_txt_record_lookup
tools.title: TXT Record Lookup
tools.description: Free public API. Fetch all TXT records on a domain, classifying each as SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI, verification token, or general.

domain.description: Domain to fetch TXT records for.

ok.description: Always true here; failures return an isError result instead.

category.description: SPF | DMARC | DKIM | Verification | MTA-STS | Other.

service.description: For verification tokens, the service that issued it.

outputSchema.description: All TXT records on the domain, classified.

tools.name: tools_website_status_checker
tools.title: Website Status Checker
tools.description: Free public API. Check if a website is up or down. Returns HTTP status, response time, final URL after redirects, basic SSL info.

ok.description: Always true here; failures return an isError result instead.

up.description: true when the status is below 500.

status.description: HTTP status; 0 if the request failed.

outputSchema.description: Whether the site is up, with timing and basic SSL info.

tools.name: tools_dkim_record_checker
tools.title: DKIM Record Checker
tools.description: Free public API. Look up the DKIM record at <selector>._domainkey.<domain>, parse the public key, flag issues.

ok.description: Always true here; failures return an isError result instead.

outputSchema.description: The DKIM record at the selector, parsed and validated.

tools.name: tools_domain_availability_checker
tools.title: Domain Availability Checker
tools.description: Free public API. Check availability of a name across one or more TLDs. Pass a `name` (no TLD) and an optional `tlds` array.

tlds.description: Optional list of TLDs to check, e.g. ['com', 'io', 'dev']. Default: a standard SaaS set.

ok.description: Always true here; failures return an isError result instead.

available.description: true = appears unregistered, false = registered, null = could not tell.

outputSchema.description: Availability of the name per TLD.
